text:
Alex: Hosting a cozy LAN + couch party Friday night. Projector ready, room for ~6. who wants in? :popcorn:
Jen: Count me in for Mario Kart and Smash. :racing_car:
Ben: I'll bring my PS5 and a pile of coop indies. Also a spare DualSense and charging station.
Maria: I can bring a Switch and my dock. What time?
Alex: 7pm start, aim to crash by 11-ish. Food + casual vibes.
David: I can bring an ethernet switch and a tiny travel router if anyone needs to jump on the LAN.
Jen: Game suggestions: Smash, Mario Kart, Rocket League, Overcooked. Also down for some tower defense co-op.
Ben: +1 Overcooked for peak chaos. Also bring a GameCube adapter if we're doing classic Smash.
Alex: I'll set up a Steam lobby for the PC stuff. Name: `redwood-cozy-lan`. Password: `muffin`. (Will DM the final creds).
Maria: Please label stuff this time. Last party we had a mystery controller that never went home. :sweat_smile:
lobby-bot: Poll created: "Which games should be on rotation?" Options: Smash, Mario Kart, Overcooked, Rocket League, Valheim. React with +1 to vote.
David: +1 Smash, +1 Rocket League
Jen: +1 Mario Kart, +1 Smash
Ben: +1 Overcooked, +1 Valheim (for late-night chill)
Maria: +1 Mario Kart, +1 Overcooked
Alex: Current tally: Smash 3, Mario Kart 2, Overcooked 3, Rocket League 1, Valheim 1. Looks like Overcooked & Smash are main events.
Jen: I can bring an HDMI switch so we don't unplug consoles between matches. lifesaver.
Ben: Also bringing backup power bank and extra ethernet cable.
David: If anyone wants to host a small Rocket League mini-tourney I can handle brackets.
Alex: Snacks sign-up: Ben drinks, Maria sweets, Jen chips. I'll handle pizza order at 6:45 unless someone is allergic to dairy.
Maria: FYI I have a couple of floor cushions and a bean bag.
Ben: Reminder: bring wired controllers for low latency on PC.
Jen: I'll bring my portable speaker for a background playlist. Nothing too loud.
Alex: Final: Friday 7pm. Address DM. Please RSVP here if your plans change. See you for couches and chaos! :video_game:
